nodes.description: public string name token name set in constructor
public string symbol token symbol set in constructor
public uint8 decimals set to 9 in constructor
uint256 _totalSupply total token supply minted to deployer
mapping(address=>uint) balances internal ledger of token holdings
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowed ERC20 allowance ledger
constructor that initializes name, symbol, decimals, total supply and credits msg.sender
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus balances of address(0)
balanceOf(address) view returning balances[tokenOwner]
allowance(address,address) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approve(address,uint) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transfer(address,uint) moves balances from msg.sender to recipient using safeSub/safeAdd
transferFrom(address,address,uint) moves balances and deducts allowance from msg.sender without an allowance sufficiency check
SafeMath safeAdd(uint,uint) returning a+b with require(c>=a)
SafeMath safeSub(uint,uint) requiring b<=a then returning a-b
SafeMath safeMul(uint,uint) returning a*b with division overflow check
SafeMath safeDiv(uint,uint) requiring b>0 then returning a/b
msg.sender used as the caller identity for allowance, balances and minting
arithmetic subtraction via safeSub on balances[msg.sender] in transfer; underflow guarded only by require in safeSub
arithmetic subtraction via safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom
access control: transferFrom deducts allowed[from][msg.sender] without verifying the spender has sufficient allowance
address tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf used to index balances
address tokenOwner parameter of allowance used to index allowed
address spender parameter of allowance used to index allowed
address spender parameter of approve written into allowed[msg.sender] slot
uint tokens parameter of approve written into allowed
address to parameter of transfer credited via safeAdd
uint tokens parameter of transfer debited/credited via safeSub/safeAdd
address from parameter of transferFrom used as debit source and allowance owner
address to parameter of transferFrom credited via safeAdd
uint tokens parameter of transferFrom used for balance and allowance debit
uint a left operand parameter shared by safeAdd, safeSub, safeMul and safeDiv
uint b right operand parameter shared by safeAdd, safeSub, safeMul and safeDiv
uint c return value local of SafeMath arithmetic functions

edges.reason: constructor assigns the literal name to state variable name
constructor assigns the literal symbol to state variable symbol
constructor assigns decimals = 9
constructor sets _totalSupply to the initial token amount
constructor credits the entire supply to balances[msg.sender]
msg.sender is the untrusted caller whose address receives the minted supply in the constructor
msg.sender used as the index into the balances mapping for the initial mint
totalSupply reads _totalSupply
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply
tokenOwner parameter flows into the balanceOf return lookup
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner]
tokenOwner parameter flows into the allowance lookup
spender parameter flows into the allowance lookup
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
spender parameter of approve is written into the allowance key
tokens parameter of approve is the approved allowance amount
msg.sender determines which allowance slot approve can modify
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens
to parameter of transfer is the credited account
tokens parameter of transfer is the amount debited and credited
msg.sender is the untrusted source account debited by transfer
transfer updates balances for msg.sender and to
transfer invokes safeSub on balances[msg.sender] which is the arithmetic sensitive operation
result of the safeSub computation is written back into the balances mapping
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance
from parameter of transferFrom is the debited account and allowance owner
to parameter of transferFrom is the credited account
tokens parameter of transferFrom is the amount debited from balance and allowance
msg.sender is the untrusted spender whose allowance is deducted in transferFrom
transferFrom rewrites balances[from] and balances[to]
transferFrom rewrites allowed[from][msg.sender]
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balance and allowance arithmetic
subtraction result is stored back into the balances mapping
transferFrom reaches the operation that spends another account allowance without validating its sufficiency
the unchecked allowance write targets allowed[from][msg.sender]
operand a flows into safeAdd addition
operand b flows into safeAdd addition
safeAdd writes the sum into return local c
operand a flows into safeSub subtraction
operand b flows into safeSub subtraction and its b<=a guard
safeSub writes the difference into return local c
operand a flows into safeMul multiplication
operand b flows into safeMul multiplication and overflow check
safeMul writes the product into return local c
operand a flows into safeDiv division
operand b flows into safeDiv divisor check b>0
safeDiv writes the quotient into return local c

normalization_plan.reason: tokenOwner is only a lookup key for balanceOf and carries no independent state
tokenOwner is only a lookup key for allowance and carries no independent state
spender is only a lookup key for allowance and carries no independent state
spender is a transient argument written into the allowed mapping by approve
tokens is a transient allowance amount only meaningful inside approve
to is a transient recipient argument consumed by transfer
tokens is a transient amount argument consumed by transfer
from is a transient source argument consumed by transferFrom
to is a transient recipient argument consumed by transferFrom
tokens is the value directly manipulated by the unchecked allowance and balance subtraction
operand a is a shared transient arithmetic argument represented by the SafeMath helper functions
operand b is a shared transient arithmetic argument represented by the SafeMath helper functions
local c is only the transient return slot of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers
